text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's chocolates.
If I'm buying some... it has to be from a proper shop!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
This shop is expensive, so
I usually just walk right past it, but...

text_block_list.name: Chocolatier Staff
text_block_list.text: Welcome~.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh... That said,
if I buy it from a shop like this...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Here, Trainer! Chocolates for you♪

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...What's with that?
Was she always the type to do something so fancy?

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
It's the Central! She's obsessed with the Central!
She studied abroad there, and now she's totally swept up in it!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I can't... I can't buy this so lightly...
If I buy it, they'll say I sold my soul..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Our only choice is to come up with our own
unique chocolates and make them ourselves...!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Miho Dorm Leader, I swallow my pride to ask a favor of you.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Could I perhaps...
borrow the dorm kitchen?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I need to think about what kind of chocolate to make.
If a Tracen girl gives Trainer a better chocolate than mine...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer will be swayed...
Deceived by false sweetness,
and end up losing what's truly precious.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: To make sure that doesn't happen, pour it into the chocolate... the Funabashi spirit!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And on Valentine's Day.
The place Furioso called me to was...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It's a mountain stream near Central Tracen.
By the way, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember the creature that often appears
at Funabashi Racecourse?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Creatures commonly seen around Funabashi...
The ones that come to mind are...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Naturally, that's one of them, but aside from that. Here's a hint—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: "It's right here. They often live around watersides like this."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...The waterside. That sparked an idea.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's a crayfish. They often wander onto the course.
I keep them as pets too.
So, with that said...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Give this to the Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: No, of course that's not it. Go ahead and open it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Opening it revealed... chocolates shaped like crayfish.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I made this faithful replica modeled after
my pet crayfish, "Zariro." I call it...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Enraged Crawfish-ro chocolate.
The pose roaring up at the heavens
embodies the fierce spirit of Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was crafted with remarkable precision.
Knowing the earnest Furioso, she must have poured hours of meticulous work into it.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'll give you another one next year.
One more little guy.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you one the year after next, too.
Its quality improves with every passing year.
choice_data_list: I see. What incredible drive to improve...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"So without being swayed by the Chuo,
we will cherish these bonds, and then—"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Let us gather the whole Crayfish Family together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, I received the first piece from the baffling set of crayfish chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer.
For taking the trouble to come out here.
choice_data_list: The park... Why are you here?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: The reason is... because that's there. Look closely. At the pond right in front of us.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: We used to ride it a lot at Funabashi back in the day, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso and I used to ride together so often...
Back then, all we had were our dreams...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, every day was fun.
Though it already feels like a distant past...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Thinking back to those days...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Here, open this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Opening the wrapping, there was...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I tried making the 'boat' from Funabashi out of chocolate.
It's shaped just like the boat we used to ride together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just looking at it brings back so many memories.
What we talked about back then was...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, someday, not just Funabashi Racecourse,
but this park too...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Let's fill it with customers.
And make the whole town lively. It's a promise!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, ever since back then...
I feel like I've been on a journey in a tiny little boat.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Adrift together on the waves in the Central sea,
forever...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And this journey... will not end
until I obtain what I desire. It cannot end.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Our boat is small.
But as long as we're together, there's no need to fear.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Let's see this through to the very end, and then go home.
Someday, back to the Funabashi Training Center.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Their boat... continues to move forward.
For now, they are still in the middle of their journey.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, we took a pinch of the same chocolate.
It had a slightly sweet flavor with a hint of salt.
